t: You're at University College London, known as UCL, a public research university and a member of the federal University of London. It is the second-largest university in the United Kingdom by total enrolment and the largest by postgraduate enrolment. It was founded by Henry Brougham, later Baron Brougham and Vaux, a barrister and politician who became Lord Chancellor. He played a prominent role in passing the Reform Act of 1832 and the Slavery Abolition Act of 1833.
